---
title: "PVJJB"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)


```

```{r}
PVJ <- read_excel(file.choose())

View(PVJ)
head(PVJ)
names(PVJ)
```


```{r}


ggplot(PVJ, aes(x = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Grades",
    x = "Grade",
    y = "Number of Grades"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(PVJ, aes(x = "", fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ Subject) +
  labs(
    title = "Grade Distribution by Subject",
    fill = "Grade"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```



```{r}
ggplot(PVJ, aes(x = factor(`Course Level`), fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Grades by Course Level",
    x = "Course Level",
    y = "Number of Grades",
    fill = "Grade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(PVJ, aes(x = "", fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_grid(`Course Level` ~ Subject) +
  labs(
    title = "Grade Distribution by Subject and Course Level",
    subtitle = "Comparison of grades across subjects and course levels",
    fill = "Grade"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
